set.ref.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style shared by <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: a 2D anime sky painting with loose, bold brushstrokes and thick palette-knife dabs of colour, electric cyan, violet and hot magenta nebula light against deep navy night, fiery orange and gold sunset glow, charcoal-black storm-cloud silhouettes and teal cloud masses, with stars painted as single bright flecks.
<Subject 2> is the nebula column seen in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a towering plume of billowing smoke with a glowing core of electric cyan, violet and hot magenta, lit from below in fiery orange and gold, its edges breaking into charcoal-black cloud and drifting embers.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing the sun setting at the centre of the horizon over a teal sea of clouds and still water pools, with <Subject 2> rising from the horizon just right of centre and a pink meteor streaking in from the upper left.
<Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 2] at 00:05.000, showing the view looking straight up through the inside of <Subject 2>, with two large glowing meteors cutting across the frame and orange fire light at the bottom.
<Picture 3> is the first frame of [Shot 3] at 00:10.000, showing a deep starfield above the curved horizon of the cloud sea, a large dark planet with a cyan rim at upper left, the galaxy band sweeping down on the right, and thin meteor trails falling.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A fifteen-second 16:9 painted sky sequence in <Subject 1>, three shots of five seconds each that open on <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: a sunset over the cloud sea where <Subject 2> rises, a climb up through the inside of <Subject 2> past streaking meteors, and an arrival high above the clouds in a deep starfield.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (applies to every shot): fully_preserved - the loose brushwork, thick textured paint dabs, flat painted stars and the cyan, violet, magenta, orange and navy palette hold in every frame.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the same plume shape, glowing cyan, violet and magenta core, orange underlight and charcoal edges.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the opening composition, the sun centred on the horizon, the column right of centre and the cloud sea with its water pools.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] first frame): fully_preserved - the upward view through the column, the two large meteors and the fire glow at the bottom.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] first frame): fully_preserved - the curved horizon, the dark planet at upper left, the galaxy band on the right and the falling meteor trails.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 2D anime-style painted sky in motion, in <Subject 1>: every cloud, plume and star keeps its visible brush texture as it moves, warm sunset gold against cold cyan and navy.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, a wide view from just above the cloud tops. The sun sits on the centre of the horizon and slowly sinks, its glow pulsing and spilling a wide band of orange across the sky and a shimmering column of reflected light down the still water pools in the foreground. Just right of centre, <Subject 2> churns and billows upward from the horizon, its cyan, violet and magenta core rippling as the charcoal-black cloud masses on both sides drift slowly outward. The pink meteor in the upper left streaks down toward the horizon and fades, and a second thinner meteor follows it. Teal clouds roll slowly toward the camera, and the reflections on the water break into ripples. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the base of <Subject 2>.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>, looking straight up through the inside of <Subject 2>. Grey-violet smoke billows curl and roll around the edges of the frame, the cyan and magenta core glows brighter at the centre, and orange fire light flickers up from the bottom as embers drift upward past the camera. The two large meteors blaze across the frame, the left one burning pink and orange as it falls toward the lower left, the right one trailing violet light toward the lower right, while smaller meteors flick past near the top. The camera pedestals up with large amplitude at slow speed, rising through the column as the smoke parts and patches of starfield open overhead.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to <Picture 3>, high above the cloud sea after sunset. The large dark planet with its glowing cyan rim hangs in the upper left and turns very slowly, the galaxy band sweeps down the right side in cyan, violet and soft magenta and shimmers as its flecks drift, and thin meteor trails keep falling across the sky one after another. Along the curved horizon the thin band of orange and pink fades slowly toward blue, and the dark cloud mass on the right sinks into shadow. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, widening the starfield as the last warm light on the horizon dims.

overall_soundscape:
A low wind hum sweeps across the cloud sea in [Shot 1], with soft airy whooshes as the meteors pass. Inside the column in [Shot 2], a deep rolling rumble and the crackle of drifting embers build as the two large meteors roar past close to the camera. In [Shot 3] the rumble falls away to a thin, quiet wind high above the clouds, with faint distant whooshes from the falling meteor trails.

non_diegetic_music:
Slow synth pads over a soft sub-bass drone open the clip; at 00:05.000 a pulsing low synth bass and a soft kick at about 70 BPM enter and build in volume through [Shot 2]; at 00:10.000 the drums drop out and a sparse high bell arpeggio rings over the sustained pads, fading out at the end.
